verdict.rationale: Rollbar clearly supports mute/ignore via item Active/Resolved/Muted/Archived statuses and configurable notification rules (Slack, PagerDuty, webhooks), which helps reduce noise, but there is no evidence of explicit 'spike protection' or 'per-key rate limiting' features to throttle alert volume during a bad deploy. missing for 10: spike protection mechanism, per-key/per-project rate limiting, documented anti-alert-storm configuration, independent SRE validation of noise reduction in practice.
